integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically for every integer q at least two. Finite SymPy checks support reproducibility but do not substitute for the proof. Self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; a full-landmark Nyström instance; deterministic complete block sketches; no claim of slower finite-tolerance convergence, wall-clock performance, or stochastic-sketch behavior. Specialized earlier coverage remains possible; independent validation not performed.
title: A two-eigenvalue kernel system whose sketched block preconditioner requires arbitrarily many exact CG steps
